description: Mailgun private API keys committed in source: a legacy key-<32> key in a mailgun-js invoice mailer, and a current-format key (prefix-less <32 hex>-<8 hex>-<8 hex>, the shape the dashboard issues today) passed to mailgun.js client(). Either can send mail as the verified domain. VC140 must fire on both; the current-format key was missed while VC140 only knew the key- prefix.
